description: Classic YouTube thumbnail: background photo, cut-out subject, huge outlined text.

fields.text: Main text (3-5 words). *word* = accent color, \n = new line
fields.bg: Background image (a frame from tools/thumbnails.sh, or any photo)
fields.subject: Cut-out PNG of you or an object (make it with tools/cutout.sh)
fields.side: Where the subject goes: right (default) or left
fields.badge: Small label in the corner, e.g. NEW or 2026
